BiblicalUsage: Yâtsîy means offspring, what comes forth from a man's own body. When Sennacherib returned in shame to his own land and went into the house of his god, those who came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the proud king falls by his own house, and God judges him through his own sons.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
